factions.canonStatus: Preserved from faction database and realm codex
factions.loreIdentity: A divine solar civilization of judgment, radiance, command, sacred order, temple law, and ancient solar mathematics.
factions.worldview: Sacred order channels solar power into civilization.
factions.leader: Not explicitly established in current faction database/realm codex; do not invent until Lore Director defines it.
factions.centralConflict: Their law can heal chaos, but it can also harden into tyranny when other Realms refuse the Solar Measure.
factions.visualIdentity: Gold, bronze, sacred geometry, solar light, obsidian enamel, amber Radiance, pyramid-pylon armor forms.
realmHazards: Judgment rays that expose hidden lies
mirage courts that repeat failed choices
factions.combatPhilosophy: Defensive command, radiant control, judgment zones, solar sustain.
factions.factionPassive: Solar Law: coordinated deities gain defensive clarity after holding objectives.
factions.mixingRule: Current canon keeps faction identity separated unless a campaign rule explicitly permits a mixed chosen deity.
factions.titanDesignPhilosophy: Every Aten Ra deity expresses Defensive command, radiant control, judgment zones, solar sustain. through a solo resource, reaction, stance, execution, or terrain rule rather than a generic stat bonus.
factions.enemyDesignPhilosophy: Enemies in Aten Ra content should test the faction conflict: Their law can heal chaos, but it can also harden into tyranny when other Realms refuse the Solar Measure.
